name: BLUE_DB
tagline: A local-level election database for 52 European countries and territories (2001–2026).
description_short: BLUE_DB is a Europe-wide database of municipality-level results of national parliamentary and European Parliament elections.
citation: Hublet, F., & Chiecchio, N. (2026). BLUE_DB — Basic Local Units Election Database. Paris: Groupe d'études géopolitiques. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21434111

code.name: MIT License
code.applies_to: The BLUE_DB code, the blue_maps library and this viewer.

data.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
data.applies_to: The election results, party and geographic typology tables assembled by BLUE_DB, as published on Zenodo. The Jersey and Guernsey results are not part of the Zenodo record and are not covered by this licence.
data.attribution: Data: BLUE_DB (Hublet & Chiecchio 2026), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21434111, CC BY 4.0, modified from official sources listed in ATTRIBUTION.md. Contains Parliamentary information licensed under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0 and public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence.

third_party.name: Administrative boundaries — Eurostat GISCO
third_party.note: © EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries. Boundaries are not part of the BLUE_DB dataset; this viewer displays simplified GISCO boundaries for non-commercial use, under Eurostat's terms.

third_party.name: Boundaries — OpenStreetMap
third_party.note: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Boundaries for Armenia, the Faroe Islands, Guernsey, the Isle of Man, Jersey and the Georgian cities, and the sources of several geoBoundaries layers, are derived from OpenStreetMap data, available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0).

third_party.name: Boundaries — geoBoundaries
third_party.note: Runfola et al. (2020), PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866. Boundaries for Andorra, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Gibraltar, Greenland, Kosovo, Moldova, Monaco, Montenegro, San Marino and Türkiye, each under the licence geoBoundaries records for its source (public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY 3.0 IGO or ODbL).

third_party.name: Westminster constituencies — Office for National Statistics
third_party.note: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right.

third_party.name: Ukrainian hromadas — OCHA / HDX
third_party.note: Ukraine Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB), OCHA FISS, source SSPE "Kartographia", CC BY-IGO.

third_party.name: Malta localities — Malta Spatial Data Infrastructure
third_party.note: © Planning Authority, Malta (MSDI), CC BY-NC-ND. The locality boundaries are shared unmodified; Malta's electoral districts are merged from them in your browser and are not distributed by BLUE_DB.

third_party.name: Basemap — Natural Earth
third_party.note: World land outline, 1:50m scale, simplified. Natural Earth is public domain; no permission or attribution is required to use it.

third_party.name: Party colours and identifiers — Wikidata
third_party.note: Party colours (P465) and identifiers are taken from Wikidata, released under CC0 1.0.

third_party.name: Party crosswalk — Party Facts
third_party.note: Party Facts identifiers link BLUE_DB parties to other party datasets. Döring, H. & Regel, S. (2019), Party Politics 25(2): 97–109.
